function prepare_room_load_statements() for kind, query in pairs(room_load_queries) do local statement, code = db:prepare(query) local retries = 0 while not statement and (code == sqlite3.BUSY or code == sqlite3.LOCKED) and retries < max_retries do ColourNote("yellow", "red", string.format("MAPPER ERROR: %s. "\nCODE: " .. tostring(code) .. "\nQUERY: " .. query, 2) end if retries > 0 then ColourNote("black", "greenyellow", string.format("MAPPER SUCCESS AFTER RETRIES: `%s`", query)) end room_load_statements[kind] = statement end end
function close_map_database() local code = db:close() assert(code == sqlite3.OK, "Map database close failed (code " .. tostring(code) .. ")") room_load_statements = {} end
function open_map_database(initializing) if db and db:isopen() then close_map_database() end db = assert (sqlite3.open(GetInfo (66) .. db_name .. ".db")) if not initializing then prepare_room_load_statements() end end
function forceOpenDB() force_nests = force_nests+1 if not db:isopen() then forced_opened = true open_map_database() end end
function closeDBifForcedOpen() force_nests = force_nests-1 if forced_opened and (force_nests <= 0) then force_nests = 0 forced_opened = false close_map_database() end end
function DBisOpen(warn) if db:isopen() then return true end if warn then Note("MAPPER ERROR: The map database is closed for safety when not connected to Aardwolf. If you want to change the DB, please connect to the game.") end return false end
-- Keep a temporarily opened database open until the row iterator is exhausted. function dbnrowsWRAPPER(query, scalar_rows) forceOpenDB() local rows = scalar_rows and db.urows or db.nrows local ok, iter, vm, i = pcall(rows, db, query)
local count = 0 while (not ok) and (count < max_retries) do local code = db:errcode() ColourNote("yellow", "red", string.format("MAPPER ERROR: %s. Retrying %dX just in case: `%s`", db:errmsg():upper(), max_retries, query)) if (code ~= sqlite3.BUSY) and (code ~= sqlite3.LOCKED) then break end db:exec("ROLLBACK") local socket = require "socket" socket.sleep(sleep_duration) ok, iter, vm, i = pcall(rows, db, query) count = count + 1 end
if (not dbcheck(db:errcode(), db:errmsg(), query)) and (count > 0) then ColourNote("black", "greenyellow", string.format("MAPPER SUCCESS AFTER RETRIES: `%s`", query)) end
local function finish_row(...) if not ... then closeDBifForcedOpen() return nil end return ... end
local function itwrap(vm, i) return finish_row(iter(vm, i)) end
return itwrap,vm,i end
function dbCheckExecute(query,incremental_continent_update) forceOpenDB() local code = db:exec(query) local count = 0 while ((code == sqlite3.BUSY) or (code == sqlite3.LOCKED)) and (count < max_retries) do ColourNote("yellow", "red", string.format("MAPPER ERROR: %s. Retrying %dX just in case: `%s`", db:errmsg():upper(), max_retries, query)) db:exec("ROLLBACK") local socket = require "socket" socket.sleep(sleep_duration) code = db:exec(query) count = count + 1 end
if (not dbcheck(code, db:errmsg(), query)) and (count > 0) then ColourNote("black", "greenyellow", string.format("MAPPER SUCCESS AFTER RETRIES: `%s`", query)) end
closeDBifForcedOpen() if mapper.continents and not incremental_continent_update then local sql=query:lower() -- Invalidate the continent room index after manual database edits. for _,name in ipairs({"rooms","exits","bookmarks","environments"}) do if sql:match("into%s+"..name.."[%s%(]") or sql:match("update%s+"..name.."%s") or sql:match("from%s+"..name.."[%s;]") and sql:match("delete%s") then mapper.continents.invalidate_rooms() break end end end end
function dbcheck (code, msg, query) if code ~= sqlite3.OK and -- no error code ~= sqlite3.ROW and -- completed OK with another row of data code ~= sqlite3.DONE then -- completed OK, no more rows local err = msg.."\n\nCODE: "..code.."\nQUERY: "..query.."\n" db:exec("ROLLBACK") -- rollback any transaction to unlock the database closeDBifForcedOpen() error(err, 3) -- show error in caller's context end end
function fixsql (s) if s then return "'" .. (string.gsub (s, "'", "''")) .. "'" -- replace single quotes with two lots of single quotes else return "NULL" end end
function fixbool (b) if b then return 1 else return 0 end end

function map_areas (name, line, wildcards) local line = "" local query = "" local area = wildcards[1] or "" local count = 0

-- map_list function contributed by Spartacus function map_list (name, line, wildcards) -- ok, so if I want to lookup a room in my db, I don't want it only if the mapper can find a sw in a certain # of rooms. -- if it is in the db, I want its vnum and area, so that I can figure out how to get there if the mapper does not know. local count = 0 Note("+------------------------------ START OF SEARCH -------------------------------+") -- find matching rooms using FTS3 local name = "%"..wildcards[1].."%" if string.sub(wildcards[1],1,1) == "\"" and string.sub(wildcards[1],-1) == "\"" then name = string.sub(wildcards[1],2,-2) end
-- faster than "SELECT uid, name, area FROM rooms WHERE name LIKE %s ORDER BY area LIMIT 101" for row in dbnrowsWRAPPER(string.format ("SELECT rooms_lookup.uid as uid, rooms_lookup.name as name, area FROM (select uid, name FROM rooms_lookup WHERE name LIKE %s) AS rooms_lookup JOIN rooms ON rooms_lookup.uid = rooms.uid ORDER BY area LIMIT 101;", fixsql (name))) do if count < 100 then print (string.format("(%s) %s is in area \"%s\"",row.uid, row.name, row.area)) end count = count + 1 end -- finding room if count > 100 then mapper.mapprint(string.format("More than 100 search results found. local function format_speedwalk_commands (path, prefix)
if GetOption("enable_command_stack")==1 then command_separator = GetAlphaOption("command_stack_character") else command_separator = "\r\n" end
-- build speedwalk string (collect identical directions) local tspeed = {} for _, dir in ipairs (path) do local n = #tspeed if n == 0 then table.insert (tspeed, { dir = dir.dir, count = 1 }) else if expand_direction[dir.dir] ~= nil and tspeed [n].dir == dir.dir then tspeed [n].count = tspeed [n].count + 1 else table.insert (tspeed, { dir = dir.dir, count = 1 }) end end end
if #tspeed == 0 then return end -- nowhere to go (current room?)
-- now build string like: 2n3e4(sw) local s = ""
local new_command = false for _, dir in ipairs (tspeed) do if expand_direction[dir.dir] ~= nil then if new_command then s = s .. command_separator .. speedwalk_prefix .. " " new_command = false end if dir.count > 1 then s = s .. dir.count end s = s .. dir.dir else s = s .. command_separator .. dir.dir new_command = true end end
if prefix ~= nil then if s:sub(1, #command_separator) == command_separator then s = s:sub(#command_separator+1) else s = prefix.." "..s end end
s = string.gsub(s, ";", command_separator)
return s, command_separator end
function start_speedwalk (path)
if not check_connected () then return end
if player_state == 9 or player_state == 11 then Send("stand") end
if not path then return end if #path == 0 then SetStatus ("Ready") return end
last_destination_uid = path[#path].uid local s = speedwalk_prefix .. " " local p = format_speedwalk_commands (path) if p:sub(1,1) ~= command_separator then s = s .. p else s = p:sub(2) end ExecuteWithWaits(s:gsub(";","\r\n")) end
